devices.line: Ƙwaƙwalwarka, saitunanka da ayyukanka a wayarka ko wata kwamfuta ma. Ɗawainiya tana zama a na'urar da aka yi ta, har sai ka aika ta zuwa wata.
devices.lineStore: Ɗawainiyoyinka, fayilolinka, ƙwaƙwalwarka da saitunanka a wayarka ko wata kwamfuta ma, a rufe ta yadda na'urorinka kaɗai za su iya karanta su.
devices.here: Wannan na'urar, an ƙara ta a {date}
devices.store.full: Ya cika: sabon abu yana zama a wannan na'urar.
devices.store.owed: Ana fitar da na'urar da ka cire…
devices.store.gone: Wannan na'urar ba ta ƙara samun abin da sauran na'urorinka suke yi.
devices.store.room: Babu sauran sarari a wannan na'urar: babu abin da zai ƙara zuwa gare ta.
devices.store.unreached: Wannan na'ura ba ta iya kaiwa ga sauran na'urorinka yanzu: abin da ya canza a nan zai jira har sai ta iya.
devices.pasteHint: A na'urar da ke da {name} ɗinka, za ka sami hanyar haɗi a Ƙara na'ura. Liƙa ta a nan don samun wannan {name} a wannan na'urar ma.
devices.qr: Hanyar haɗin a matsayin lambar QR, don kyamarar ɗayan na'urarka
devices.point: Nuna kyamarar ɗayan na'urarka ga lambar, ko ka aika mata hanyar haɗin.
devices.pasteThere: Liƙa wannan hanyar haɗin a cikin {name} a ɗayan na'urarka, a {place}.
devices.link: Hanyar haɗin da za a buɗe a ɗayan na'urarka
devices.codeHint: Suna bayyana a sabuwar na'urar da zarar ta buɗe hanyar haɗin. Gwaji uku.

devices.wrong.one: Waɗannan lambobin ba su dace ba. Gwaji {count} ya rage.
devices.wrong.other: Waɗannan lambobin ba su dace ba. Gwaje-gwaje {count} sun rage.

devices.done: An ƙara na'urar {device}. Tana buɗewa da ƙwaƙwalwarka, saitunanka da ayyukanka.
devices.coming: Ana kawo {name} ɗinka daga ɗayan na'urarka zuwa wannan, tare da ƙwaƙwalwa, saituna da ayyuka. Sannan za ka rubuta lambobi shida a can.
devices.trust: A buɗe bayanin martaba “{profile}” daga {device} a wannan na'urar? Sai idan kai da kanka ne ka zaɓi Ƙara na'ura a can yanzun nan.
devices.homeTitle: Da farko, ƙara {name} zuwa Home Screen ɗinka
devices.homeText: A iPhone ko iPad, buɗewa daga Home Screen tana keɓe abubuwan {name} daga na Safari. Taɓa Share, sannan Add to Home Screen, sai ka buɗe daga can.
devices.homePaste: A can, liƙa wannan hanyar haɗin a {place}.
devices.why.link: Wannan ba hanyar haɗi ba ce daga ɗayan na'urarka. Sake kwafe ta a can.
devices.why.used: An riga an yi amfani da wannan hanyar haɗin. A ɗayan na'urarka, sake zaɓar Ƙara na'ura don samun sabuwa.
devices.why.gone: Ɗayan na'urarka ta daina ƙara wannan. Sake farawa a can.
devices.why.key: Amsar ta fito daga wata na'ura daban da wadda ta ba da hanyar haɗin, don haka ba a ƙara komai ba. Sake farawa.
devices.why.child: Bayanin martabar yaro yana zama a na'urarsa kawai.
devices.why.relay: Ba za a iya kai wa sauran na'urorinka ba a yanzu. Duba haɗin ka sake gwadawa.
devices.why.storage: Wannan burauza ba za ta iya ajiye fayilolin {name} a nan ba, misali a taga ta sirri.
devices.why.exists: Akwai {name} ɗinka daga waccan na'urar a nan tuni.
devices.why.tries: Gwaje-gwaje uku marasa daidai: an dakatar da ƙarawa, don tsaro. Sake farawa.
devices.why.broken: Wani abu ya ɓaci. Sake gwadawa.
devices.removeText: Ba za ta ƙara samun saitunanka ba, kuma ba za a iya aika mata ɗawainiyoyi ba.
devices.notYet: Ba a sanar da na'urar {device} ba tukuna. Wannan na'urar za ta sanar da ita da kanta da zarar ta iya.
devices.erasing: Za a goge {name} daga cikinta a karo na gaba da ta buɗe.
devices.revoke: Wataƙila tana da waɗannan makullan har yanzu, tun da ba a iya karɓar makulli baya. Don tsaro, sauya kowanne a inda ka yi shi:
devices.sites: Wataƙila tana iya canza waɗannan shafuka a intanet har yanzu. Don hana hakan, buɗe kowanne, zaɓi Wallafa…, sannan Ƙirƙiri sabuwar lambar maidowa:
devices.task.kept: An ajiye wannan aiki a wannan na'urar.
devices.task.large: Wannan ɗawainiyar ta yi girma da yawa don aikawa zuwa {device}.
devices.task.gone: Na'urar {device} ba ta cikin na'urorinka kuma.
devices.task.failed: Ba a iya aika ta zuwa {device} ba. Sake gwadawa nan da ɗan lokaci.
devices.forgotten: Wata daga cikin na'urorinka ta cire wannan. Za ka ci gaba da {name} a nan, ba tare da sauran ba.
